;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Luzon earthquake]]
**Sixteen people are killed when a magnitude 6.1 [[earthquake]] strikes the municipalities of [[Porac, Pampanga|Porac]] and [[Lubao, Pampanga|Lubao]], [[Pampanga]] province, [[Philippines]] at 17:11 [[Philippine Standard Time]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/16-dead-in-luzon-quake-ndrrmc/544291/ (''The Manila Times'')]
**According to [[Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology|PHIVOLCS]], the [[epicenter]] of the earthquake is located {{convert|18|km|mi}} northeast of [[Castillejos]], [[Zambales]]. PHIVOLCS originally records the earthquake, which is tectonic in origin, at magnitude 5.7, but later upgrades it to 6.1. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/weather/692003/magnitude-5-7-earthquake-jolts-zambales/story/ (GMA News)]

*[[United States sanctions against Iran]]
**The [[United States]] demands that all countries cease purchasing oil from [[Iran]] by May 1 or face sanctions, in a move aimed at reducing Iran's income. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-iran-oil/u-s-to-end-all-waivers-on-imports-of-iranian-oil-crude-price-jumps-idUSKCN1RX0R1 (Reuters)]
